events.label: U.S. strikes on Iran begin
events.note: Operation Epic Fury. Ordered 27 Feb 2026 20:38 UTC; first coordinated airstrikes announced 28 Feb 2026 06:35 UTC. 28 Feb 2026 was a Saturday, so there is no trading bar on the date itself -- the first session after the event was Mon 2 Mar 2026, when WTI moved 67.02 to 71.23 and went on to 81.01 by 5 Mar. Later U.S. strike waves on 7 May and 7 Jul 2026 are deliberately not listed here; only the start was asked for.
